purpose: One mechanically sampled Curatorial leaf from direct Commons botanical-illustration File pages. No category recursion and no local arbitrary visual selection.

scouting_observation.basis: Commons category page as browsed, not a PetScan export or immutable inventory

scope_note: Depth 0 means direct category File members; expansion to descendants must be explicitly re-commissioned and recorded as a different snapshot.
output_limit_note: Ensure the full result is exported and detect truncation. The limit is a guard, not a sampling device.
